SIX-BOX at the BEST config (c16/ep44/lr1e-3/lneg0.03/bs1/tn400). (1) PRIOR: 3 seed replicates -- seed42(iter-8)=0.8915, seed43(iter-14)=0.8589, seed44(iter-15)=0.8317 -> mean~0.861 std~0.030, spread 0.060. Seed/init variance DOMINATES the config-knob deltas from iters 1-13. (2) Failure mode: the whole single-seed(=42) sweep was NOISE-CONFOUNDED; 0.8915 was a favorable upper-tail draw, NOT a robust config gain -- the lr/lambda_neg improvements sit within this +-0.03 band. n=3 std is itself noisy. (3) ONE KNOB: seed 45 (config identical) -- 4th replicate to stabilize mean+-std. (4) HYPOTHESIS: seed=45 lands in [0.83,0.89]; n=4 gives a stable mean (~0.86+-0.03) that is the HONEST reportable number for this config, replacing the seed-42 peak. (5) BUDGET: ~941s, inside 20-min. (6) Loop to iter-20; the headline result is now the variance characterization, so iters 17-20 add replicates to solidify the mean+-std at n=7-8. Artifacts saved.
